races.title: Sidgwick Memorial Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: DIAMOND MIX is building up a very good record round here and is weighted to repeat his win in this contest 12 months ago unless points runner-up Imperfectlyperfect proves well-above average on his first go over fences. Ghasham also has winning form over C&D and needs considering too. DIAMOND MIX (IRE) IMPERFECTLYPERFECT (IRE) GHASHAM (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Imperfectlyperfect (9/4), Ask A Sainte (4/1), Ghasham (5/1), Diamond Mix (11/2), Flash Du Pistolet (11/2), Carcaci Castle (10/1), Got Grey (12/1)

races.title: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: LUNA MARQUESA was getting the hang of things late on when fifth on her recent hurdling debut at Worcester and with this stiffer track seeming sure to suit she is fancied to get off the mark and continue the fine run of Joe Tizzard. Kamille Au Kanada is feared most in her bid for a third hurdling success, although Just A Poet can't be ruled out after a break too. LUNA MARQUESA (FR) KAMILLE AU KANADA (FR) JUST A POET
races.bettingForecast: Kamille Au Kanada (8/13), Just A Poet (4/1), Luna Marquesa (6/1), Queen Lily (7/1), Cinnamon Storm (50/1)

races.title: carpetgallop.co.uk Handicap Chase
races.verdict: Joe Tizzard's WALK TALL impressed as a future chaser in the making in a relatively light campaign over hurdles last season and this winning pointer is taken to make a successful start in this sphere. Easy C&D scorer C'Mon So rates a big threat though, while Aill Dubh appeals as the pick of the remainder. WALK TALL (IRE) C'MON SO (IRE) AILL DUBH (IRE)

races.title: carpetgallop.co.uk Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

The returning Ruby Island took well to chasing last year and is also considered, with Hombre de Guerra appealing as likely to come on from his yard debut. SEAN OG (IRE) RUBY ISLAND HOMBRE DE GUERRA (IRE)
